title: About Me
text:
I’m a passionate web developer with 10 years of experience turning ideas into functional, high-quality web solutions. I love working with modern technologies like JavaScript, React, Node.js, and Python, and I focus on writing clean, maintainable code that scales.
Whether you need a sleek portfolio site, a dynamic web app, or ongoing development support, I’m here to help bring your vision to life.
Services

Custom Websites: Responsive, fast, and visually appealing sites tailored to your brand.
Web Applications: Interactive apps with modern frameworks like React and Vue.
Maintenance & Support: Ongoing updates, bug fixes, and optimization.
Consulting: Guidance on architecture, performance, and technology choices
